title: Henry J. Kaiser Company v. McLouth Steel Corp., 257 F. Supp. 372
authors: United States District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan
version: Court opinion, section II.C(2); attributed short web-rendered excerpt
lineage: A judicial opinion reports the contents of an earlier 1949 memo; the original memo was not independently inspected.
